challenge_title: Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions
core_goal: Build a visual tool enabling astronauts to gather health indicators, assess their own physical and mental health in space, and receive preventive and treatment guidance.
recommended_indicators: blood_pressure, heart_rate, blood_sugar, body_temperature, sleep_hours, mood, ocular_ear, balance, radiation_dosimetry
supported_environments: Spacecraft, Space Station, Rover, Lunar/Planetary Base
